name: Naeba Ski Resort
desc: One of Japan's best-known ski resorts, in the Yuzawa area. A route bus runs from Echigo-Yuzawa Station (about 45 minutes).

name: Kagura Ski Resort
desc: High-elevation ski area in the Yuzawa area, linked to Naeba by the long Dragondola gondola.

name: GALA Yuzawa Snow Resort
desc: Ski resort with a Shinkansen station at its base in winter, which makes it an easy day trip from Tokyo. Check the seasonal train schedule.

name: Kandatsu Snow Resort
desc: Ski area on the southeastern slope of Mt. Iiji, about 3 km from Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

name: Yuzawa Nakazato Snow Resort
name_ja: 湯沢中里スノーリゾート
desc: Ski area near Echigo-Nakazato Station on the Joetsu Line.

name: Iwappara Ski Resort
desc: Ski area in the Yuzawa area.

name: Yuzawa Kogen Ski Area
desc: Ski area reached by a ropeway close to Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

name: Joetsu Kokusai Ski Resort
desc: Ski resort in the Yuzawa area.

name: Ishiuchi Maruyama Ski Resort
desc: Ski resort in Minamiuonuma with views over the city, about 3 km from the Shiozawa-Ishiuchi interchange.

name: Maiko Snow Resort
desc: Ski resort about 1 km from the Shiozawa-Ishiuchi interchange, one of the easiest to reach by car in the area.

name: Muika Snow Resort
name_ja: ムイカスノーリゾート
desc: Ski resort in Minamiuonuma. A shuttle bus runs from Muikamachi Station (about 10 minutes).

name: Muikamachi Hakkaisan Ski Resort
name_ja: 六日町八海山スキー場
desc: Ski resort on the slopes of Mt. Hakkai in Minamiuonuma.

name: Akakura Kanko Resort Ski Area
name_ja: 赤倉観光リゾートスキー場
desc: Large ski area in Myoko Kogen next to the Akakura Kanko Hotel, with a top elevation of about 1,500 m and runs of up to 4.5 km.

name: Akakura Onsen Ski Area
desc: Ski area at the foot of Mt. Myoko, about 8 minutes by car from the Myoko-Kogen interchange and close to the Akakura hot spring village.

name: Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort
desc: Long, wide ski area with runs of up to about 8.5 km and a vertical drop of roughly 1,100 m. Buses run from Myoko-Kogen Station (about 25 minutes).

name: Ikenotaira Onsen Alpen Blick Ski Area
name_ja: 池の平温泉アルペンブリックスキー場
desc: Wide, open slope at the foot of Mt. Myoko.

name: Lotte Arai Resort
name_ja: ロッテアライリゾート
desc: Resort and ski area in Myoko.

name: Shirataki Brewery
desc: Yuzawa brewery known for the Jozen Mizu no Gotoshi and Minatoya Tosuke brands. Winter brewery tours are offered by reservation; check the brewery's site.

name: Ponshukan Sake Museum (Echigo-Yuzawa Station)
name_ja: ぽんしゅ館 越後湯沢驛店
desc: Coin-operated sake tasting inside Echigo-Yuzawa Station, covering breweries from across Niigata. Easy to visit while changing trains.

name: Hakkaisan Brewery
desc: Maker of Hakkaisan sake, one of Niigata's best-known brands, in Minamiuonuma at the foot of Mt. Hakkai.

name: Uonuma no Sato (Hakkaisan complex)
desc: Visitor complex run by Hakkaisan with shops, restaurants, a craft beer brewery and a snow storehouse. About 10 minutes by taxi from Itsukamachi Station.

name: Aoki Shuzo
desc: One of the oldest breweries in the Minamiuonuma area, founded in 1717.

name: Takachiyo Shuzo
desc: Brewery at the foot of Mt. Makihata, known for dry sake. Brewery tours are not available.

name: Midorikawa Shuzo
desc: Brewery in Uonuma City, known for the Midorikawa brand.

name: Myoko Shuzo
desc: Joetsu brewery making Myokosan sake with water from Mt. Myoko. Brewery visits by prior consultation.

name: Musashino Shuzo
desc: Brewery in Joetsu's Takada district, about a 10-minute walk from Takada Station.

name: Maruyama Shuzojo (Setchubai)
desc: Joetsu brewery known for the Setchubai brand. No brewery tours.

name: Yoshikawa Toji no Sato
desc: Brewery in Joetsu's Yoshikawa district producing Yoshikawa Toji sake.

name: Kiminoi Shuzo
desc: Brewery in Myoko City.

name: Ayumasamune Shuzo
desc: Brewery in Myoko City.

name: Chiyonohikari Shuzo
desc: Brewery in Myoko City.

name: Echigo-Yuzawa Station
desc: Shinkansen gateway to the Yuzawa ski areas, about 70 minutes from Tokyo Station at the fastest. Ponshukan sake tasting is inside the station.

name: Echigo-Nakazato Station
desc: Joetsu Line station close to the Yuzawa Nakazato ski area.

name: Urasa Station
desc: Joetsu Shinkansen stop in Minamiuonuma.

name: Muikamachi Station
desc: Joetsu Line station in Minamiuonuma. Shuttle buses to some local ski areas depart from here.

name: Nagaoka Station
desc: Major Joetsu Shinkansen stop, with a Ponshukan sake shop.

name: Niigata Station
desc: Main station of Niigata City and the northern end of the Joetsu Shinkansen. A Ponshukan sake shop is here too.

name: Niigata Airport
desc: Niigata's airport, on the coast near Niigata City.

name: Joetsumyoko Station
desc: Hokuriku Shinkansen stop and the usual starting point for the Myoko area.

name: Myoko-Kogen Station
desc: Station on the Echigo Tokimeki Railway (Myoko Haneuma Line) in the Myoko ski area. Buses run from here to Suginohara.
